summarize_model_config: summarize the TinyViT-21m model configuration dictionary for image classification
review_model_config: review the TinyViT-21m backbone and LinearClsHead settings in the model config
build_image_classifier: build an ImageClassifier using the TinyViT-21m backbone with 1000 classes
refactor_model_config: refactor the TinyViT-21m model config to change the number of classes or image size
test_model_config: test the TinyViT-21m model config by instantiating the ImageClassifier with the given backbone and head
